title: Notation spec: Backgammon point notation
description:
Backgammon point notation for the notation adapter.

## Point notation
Points numbered 1-24. Special positions: bar, off.
Moves are from/to pairs: 13/7, bar/22, 6/off.

## Dice
Shown as parenthesized pair: (6-4), (3-3).
Doubles: same number means four moves available.

## Move format
{from}/{to} — one move per die value.
Full turn example: (6-4) 13/7 8/4
Hitting: 13/7* (asterisk = opponent piece sent to bar)
Bearing off: 6/off

## Multiple checkers with same move
13/7(2) = move two checkers from 13 to 7 (when doubles rolled)

## Grid labels
Track zone with 24 points. Labels: ["1","2",...,"24"] plus "bar" and "off" as special positions.

## Declarative spec
```json
{
  "notation": {
    "type": "track_based",
    "move_separator": "/",
    "special_positions": {
      "bar": "bar",
      "off": "off"
    },
    "hit_marker": "*",
    "dice_format": "({d1}-{d2})"
  }
}
```
Requires extending notation spec for track-based games. Mostly declarative but dice+multi-move turns may need WASM for full parsing.
